title: Cancel Bag Out during manual bag out to cancel exchange tasks not already in process
summary: During a manual bag out, Fortna provides a “cancel bag out” option that cancels exchange tasks that are not already in process. Use this option when you need to stop/cancel pending exchange work while allowing any exchange already in process to complete.
when_to_use: Use during a manual bag out when you need to cancel exchange tasks that are not already in process.
not_for: Do not use “cancel bag out” as a way to cancel an exchange task that is already in process; the source states those must still finish.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Initiate/confirm manual bag out in the bag out control area and select “cancel bag out” when needed; verify the cancellation scope matches “not in process” exchange tasks.
access_or_tools_needed: Bag out control UI that includes manual bag out and the “cancel bag out” option
UI/status visibility for exchange tasks and whether they are in process

system_preconditions: System is in a manual bag out scenario where the bag out control UI is available

visual_references.description: Overall System Bag Out Control UI slide showing: System bag out closes destinations and exchanges totes; manual bag out includes “cancel bag out” that cancels exchange tasks that are not in process.

steps.title: Initiate or identify the “manual bag out” state in the bag out control area
steps.purpose: Ensure you are operating in the manual bag out context where the “cancel bag out” option applies.
steps.instruction: Open the bag out control UI and confirm you are performing a manual bag out (not auto bagger control).
steps.expected_result: The bag out control UI indicates manual bag out is the active mode/context.
steps.healthy_condition: Manual bag out context is clearly selected/active in the bag out control UI.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm manual bag out is active, or the UI is showing a different bag out control context.

actions.label: Confirm manual bag out context
actions.exact_action: Identify the manual bag out option/state in the bag out control UI.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “In the event of a manual bag out Fortna offers a cancel bag out…”

steps.title: Select the “cancel bag out” option offered for manual bag out
steps.purpose: Trigger cancellation of exchange tasks that are not already in process.
steps.instruction: In the bag out control UI during manual bag out, select the “cancel bag out” option.
steps.expected_result: The system processes the “cancel bag out” action for manual bag out.
steps.healthy_condition: The “cancel bag out” option is available and can be selected during manual bag out.
steps.failure_condition: The “cancel bag out” option is not available during manual bag out.

actions.label: Cancel bag out
actions.exact_action: Select “cancel bag out” in the manual bag out control UI.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the “cancel bag out” option is not available during manual bag out.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “Fortna offers a cancel bag out that will cancel any exchange task that is not in process.”

steps.title: Verify cancellation scope: cancel exchange tasks that are “not in process”
steps.purpose: Confirm the cancellation affects only exchange tasks that are not already in process, per the source rule.
steps.instruction: After selecting “cancel bag out,” verify that exchange tasks that are not in process are canceled, while any exchange task already in process is not canceled.
steps.expected_result: Exchange tasks that are not already in process are canceled; exchange tasks already in process continue to completion.
steps.healthy_condition: UI/status shows canceled exchange tasks correspond to those that were not in process; in-process exchange tasks remain active until completion.
steps.failure_condition: Tasks that are clearly not in process are not canceled after using “cancel bag out,” or the UI contradicts the “not in process” cancellation scope.

actions.label: Check exchange task states
actions.exact_action: Inspect exchange task statuses to confirm which are “in process” vs “not in process,” and confirm cancellation occurred only for “not in process.”

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if tasks that are clearly not in process are not canceled after using “cancel bag out,” or if the UI contradicts the “not in process” cancellation scope.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “cancel any exchange task that is not in process.”

success_criteria: After selecting “cancel bag out” during manual bag out, exchange tasks that were not in process are canceled.
Exchange tasks already in process are not canceled and continue to completion.
healthy_conditions: “cancel bag out” is available during manual bag out.
Cancellation scope matches “not in process” exchange tasks.
failure_conditions: “cancel bag out” option is missing during manual bag out.
Exchange tasks not in process remain uncanceled after “cancel bag out.”
UI/status indicates cancellation affected tasks that were already in process.
escalation_guidance: If “cancel bag out” is not available during manual bag out, stop and escalate.
If cancellation scope does not match “not in process” (or UI contradicts the scope), stop and escalate.
